certifications.title: PMP
certifications.description: The gold standard certification for project managers across all industries worldwide.
certifications.metaTitle: PMP Exam Prep & Certification Coaching | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for the PMI PMP exam. Master official 2026 ECO domains (People 33%, Process 41%, Business 26%), predictive and agile methodologies, and situational questions.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility requirements for the PMP exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a 4-year degree need 36 months of project leadership experience and 35 hours of project management education. High school graduates need 60 months of experience.

faqs.question: What is the structure of the official 2026 PMP exam?
faqs.answer: The PMP exam consists of 180 questions (175 scored, 5 pretest) administered over 240 minutes, covering People (33%), Process (41%), and Business Environment (26%).

faqs.question: How much of the PMP exam covers agile and hybrid project management?
faqs.answer: Approximately 60% of the PMP exam evaluates agile or hybrid project environments alongside traditional predictive waterfall delivery frameworks.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS assist PMP candidates?
faqs.answer: We offer 1-on-1 domain coaching, scenario practice question reviews, EVM math formula sheets, and custom 4 to 12-week study schedules tailored to your test date.

faqs.question: Is the 35 hours of project management education required before applying?
faqs.answer: Yes. PMI requires completing 35 contact hours of formal project management education prior to submitting your official PMP exam application.

faqs.question: How many mock exams should I take before my PMP test date?
faqs.answer: We recommend taking 3 to 5 full-length, 180-question timed practice exams under simulated test conditions during the final month of revision.

certifications.title: CAPM
certifications.description: Entry-level PMI project management credential establishing foundational PM and agile skills.
certifications.metaTitle: CAPM Exam Prep & Certification Guide | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Master the PMI CAPM exam. Review PMBOK 7th edition fundamentals, agile principles, and business analysis with 1-on-1 tutoring and practice questions.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility requirements for the CAPM exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates need a high school diploma or global equivalent and 23 hours of formal project management education completed before taking the exam.

faqs.question: What is the format of the CAPM examination?
faqs.answer: The CAPM exam features 150 multiple-choice questions administered over 185 minutes via Pearson VUE online proctoring or testing centers.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the CAPM and PMP certifications?
faqs.answer: CAPM is an entry-level credential requiring no prior project management job experience, whereas PMP requires 3 to 5 years of professional project leadership experience.

faqs.question: Does the CAPM exam test agile and business analysis concepts?
faqs.answer: Yes! The CAPM exam outline includes dedicated domain weightings for agile principles, Scrum ceremonies, and business analysis fundamentals.

faqs.question: How long does it take to prepare for the CAPM exam?
faqs.answer: Most candidates spend 4 to 8 weeks preparing, allocating approximately 40 to 60 total hours of structured study and practice testing.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS support CAPM candidates?
faqs.answer: We provide 1-on-1 fundamental tutoring, PMBOK concept breakdowns, math formula sheets, and timed practice question walkthroughs.

certifications.title: CompTIA Certifications
certifications.description: Vendor-neutral IT certifications establishing core cybersecurity, infrastructure, and helpdesk expertise.
certifications.metaTitle: CompTIA Security+ & IT Certification Study Guide | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701), Network+, and A+ exams. Review port numbers, CLI commands, performance-based questions, and core IT domains.

faqs.question: Which CompTIA certification exams do you support?
faqs.answer: We provide prep support for CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701), Network+ (N10-008), A+ Core 1 (220-1101), and A+ Core 2 (220-1102).

faqs.question: What are Performance-Based Questions (PBQs) on CompTIA exams?
faqs.answer: PBQs appear at the start of CompTIA exams and test hands-on CLI configuration, network setup, or firewall rules rather than multiple-choice selection.

faqs.question: What core port numbers should I memorize for Security+ and Network+?
faqs.answer: Memorize SSH (22), DNS (53), HTTP (80), HTTPS (443), RDP (3389), SNMP (161/162), LDAPS (636), and SMTP (25/587).

faqs.question: Is CompTIA Security+ required for government IT roles?
faqs.answer: Yes. CompTIA Security+ is one of the most common baseline credentials fulfilling DoD 8140/8570 directive requirements for IAT Level II roles.

faqs.question: What score is required to pass CompTIA Security+ SY0-701?
faqs.answer: CompTIA Security+ requires a minimum passing score of 750 on a scale of 100 to 900.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS help CompTIA candidates?
faqs.answer: We provide 1-on-1 technical coaching, PBQ command walkthroughs, port memory flashcards, and timed practice exams.

certifications.title: SHRM Certification
certifications.description: Premier HR credentials validating behavioral competencies and HR expertise.
certifications.metaTitle: SHRM-CP & SHRM-SCP Exam Prep Guide | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP HR certification exams. Master the SHRM BASK competency model, situational judgment items, and labor law compliance.

faqs.question: What is the difference between SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP?
faqs.answer: SHRM-CP focuses on operational and tactical HR implementation, whereas SHRM-SCP is for senior executives leading strategic organizational policy.

faqs.question: What are Situational Judgment Items (SJIs) on SHRM exams?
faqs.answer: SJIs present realistic HR workplace scenarios and require candidates to select the most effective action based on the official SHRM BASK® competency model.

faqs.question: What key federal labor laws should I review for the SHRM exam?
faqs.answer: Review major federal HR statutes including FMLA, FLSA, ERISA, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, ADA, OSHA, and COBRA.

faqs.question: How many questions are on the SHRM-CP exam and what is the time limit?
faqs.answer: The SHRM-CP exam contains 134 questions (80 knowledge items, 54 situational judgment items) administered over 3 hours 40 minutes.

faqs.question: What is a passing score on the SHRM certification exam?
faqs.answer: SHRM uses a scaled scoring system ranging from 100 to 500, with a passing threshold set at a scaled score of 200.

faqs.question: How can TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS help with SHRM preparation?
faqs.answer: We offer 1-on-1 BASK domain tutoring, situational judgment item strategies, labor law quick sheets, and timed practice tests.

certifications.title: Real Estate Licensing
certifications.description: Pre-licensing exam coaching for salesperson and broker state licensing exams.
certifications.metaTitle: Real Estate Licensing Exam Prep Guide | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Comprehensive real estate salesperson and broker licensing exam prep. Review national real estate principles, contracts, financing math, and state statutes.

faqs.question: How are real estate licensing exams structured?
faqs.answer: Exams consist of two parts: a National Real Estate Principles portion (80-100 items) and a State Law portion (30-50 items specific to your jurisdiction).

faqs.question: Do real estate licensing requirements vary by state?
faqs.answer: Yes! Pre-licensing course hour requirements (ranging from 60 to 180 hours), passing score thresholds (70%-75%), and state statutes vary by state licensing commission.

faqs.question: What real estate math calculations appear on the exam?
faqs.answer: Calculations cover commission splits, property tax proration, loan-to-value (LTV) ratios, square footage/acreage, and seller net sheets.

faqs.question: Which test vendors administer real estate licensing exams?
faqs.answer: Most states deliver licensing exams through PSI Services, Pearson VUE, or AMP testing centers and secure remote proctoring.

faqs.question: What score is needed to pass the real estate licensing exam?
faqs.answer: Most state commissions require a passing score of 70% to 75% correct on both the National and State portions.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS assist real estate candidates?
faqs.answer: We provide 1-on-1 tutoring in real estate math, national principles reviews, contract law summaries, and timed practice question walkthroughs.

certifications.title: AAPC Medical Coding
certifications.description: Medical coding certifications validating mastery in physician practice coding.
certifications.metaTitle: AAPC Medical Coding Exam Prep Guide | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for AAPC medical coding credentials. Master CPT, ICD-10-CM, and HCPCS Level II codebook tabbing, guidelines, and operative report coding.

faqs.question: What is the difference between AAPC and CPC?
faqs.answer: AAPC is the national professional organization that awards medical coding credentials, while CPC (Certified Professional Coder) is a specific credential for outpatient coding.

faqs.question: Are codebooks allowed during official AAPC medical coding exams?
faqs.answer: Yes! AAPC certification exams are open-book examinations requiring current-year approved physical CPT®, ICD-10-CM, and HCPCS Level II codebooks.

faqs.question: What credentials does AAPC offer besides CPC?
faqs.answer: AAPC offers specialized credentials including CIC (Inpatient Coding), COC (Outpatient Hospital), CPMA (Auditing), and CPCO (Compliance).

faqs.question: How long is the official AAPC CPC exam?
faqs.answer: The CPC exam contains 100 multiple-choice questions administered over 4 hours (240 minutes) via online proctoring or test centers.

faqs.question: What score is required to pass AAPC coding certification exams?
faqs.answer: Candidates must achieve a score of 70% or higher correct to pass AAPC certification exams.

faqs.question: How can TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS help with AAPC exam prep?
faqs.answer: We offer 1-on-1 codebook tabbing instruction, E/M guideline walkthroughs, operative report coding practice, and timed mock tests.

certifications.title: CPC Certified Professional Coder
certifications.description: The gold standard for outpatient medical coding.
certifications.metaTitle: CPC Certified Professional Coder Exam Prep | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for the AAPC CPC medical coding exam. Review CPT surgical coding, evaluation and management guidelines, and open-book operative report cases.

faqs.question: What setting is the CPC credential designed for?
faqs.answer: The CPC credential validates expertise in physician office, group practice, and outpatient clinic coding settings.

faqs.question: What is the difference between CPC and CPC-A status?
faqs.answer: CPC-A is an Apprentice designation given to new coders until 2 years of verified coding experience or approved education equivalent is submitted to AAPC.

faqs.question: What CPT codebook sections are tested on the CPC exam?
faqs.answer: The exam covers Surgery (10000-60000 series), Evaluation & Management (99202-99499), Anesthesia, Radiology, Pathology/Lab, and Medicine.

faqs.question: How should I tab my codebooks for the CPC exam?
faqs.answer: Tab codebooks by major anatomical sections, guidelines, E/M tables, and modifier lists to quickly locate codes during the 4-hour exam.

faqs.question: What is the passing score for the CPC examination?
faqs.answer: A minimum score of 70% correct is required to pass the CPC exam.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS support CPC candidates?
faqs.answer: We provide 1-on-1 operative report coding drills, E/M table reviews, codebook tabbing strategies, and timed 100-item practice tests.

certifications.title: CCMA Certified Clinical Medical Assistant
certifications.description: Clinical medical assisting certification covering patient care, phlebotomy, and EKG.
certifications.metaTitle: NHA CCMA Certification Exam Prep Guide | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for the NHA CCMA clinical assistant exam. Review patient care, phlebotomy tube order of draw, 12-lead EKG placement, and clinical administration.

faqs.question: What organization awards the CCMA credential?
faqs.answer: The Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) credential is administered and awarded nationally by the National Healthcareer Association (NHA).

faqs.question: What is the structure and passing score of the NHA CCMA exam?
faqs.answer: The CCMA exam consists of 150 multiple-choice questions (135 scored, 15 pretest) administered over 3 hours, requiring a scaled score of 390 out of 500.

faqs.question: What key clinical skills appear on the CCMA exam?
faqs.answer: Clinical topics include vital sign measurement, phlebotomy tube order of draw, 12-lead EKG electrode placement, infection control, and pharmacology.

faqs.question: What administrative topics are tested on the CCMA exam?
faqs.answer: Administrative topics cover patient scheduling, EHR documentation, medical billing fundamentals, HIPAA privacy rules, and triage.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I study for the CCMA exam?
faqs.answer: We recommend starting 4 to 6 weeks before your scheduled NHA exam date, focusing on phlebotomy, EKG, and clinical care domains.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS help CCMA candidates?
faqs.answer: We offer 1-on-1 tutoring, EKG and phlebotomy flashcards, clinical procedure walkthroughs, and timed NHA-style mock exams.

certifications.title: CNA Certified Nursing Assistant
certifications.description: State nursing assistant certification validating fundamental patient care skills.
certifications.metaTitle: CNA Certified Nursing Assistant Exam Prep | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for state CNA written and clinical competency evaluation exams. Review vital signs, infection control, hygiene skills, and nursing fundamentals.

faqs.question: What are the two parts of the official CNA evaluation exam?
faqs.answer: The CNA exam consists of a Written Knowledge Exam (60-70 multiple-choice questions) and a hands-on Clinical Skills Demonstration (3-5 random skills).

faqs.question: Do CNA competency evaluation requirements vary by state?
faqs.answer: Yes! State boards of nursing set specific clinical training hours and designate test vendors like Prometric, Credentia, or Headmaster.

faqs.question: What are mandatory safety skills during the CNA clinical exam?
faqs.answer: Mandatory skills include hand hygiene, indirect care/patient privacy, infection control, and proper body mechanics during transfers.

faqs.question: What score is required to pass the written CNA exam?
faqs.answer: Most states require 70% to 75% correct on the written exam, plus 100% safety compliance on the clinical skills evaluation.

faqs.question: How long is the written CNA exam?
faqs.answer: The written CNA exam is usually timed for 90 minutes.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS support CNA candidates?
faqs.answer: We provide written exam practice question sets, nursing fundamentals tutoring, and clinical skill step-by-step checklists.

certifications.title: CPhT Certified Pharmacy Technician

certifications.metaTitle: PTCB CPhT Pharmacy Technician Exam Prep | TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS
certifications.metaDescription: Prepare for the PTCB CPhT pharmacy technician exam. Master top 200 brand and generic drugs, pharmacy math calculations, and federal pharmacy law.

faqs.question: What organization awards the national CPhT credential?
faqs.answer: The Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) credential is administered nationally by the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB).

faqs.question: What is the structure and time limit of the PTCB CPhT exam?
faqs.answer: The PTCB exam consists of 90 multiple-choice questions (80 scored, 10 pretest) administered over 1 hour 50 minutes (110 minutes).

faqs.question: What pharmacy math calculations appear on the PTCB exam?
faqs.answer: Calculations cover daily dosage math, alligation grids, IV flow rates, powder volume conversions, and percentage strength.

faqs.question: What federal laws are tested on the PTCB exam?
faqs.answer: Review the Controlled Substances Act (Schedules I-V), DEA registration, Durham-Humphrey Amendment, and USP <795>/<797> compounding standards.

faqs.question: What score is needed to pass the PTCB CPhT exam?
faqs.answer: PTCB uses a scaled score range from 1000 to 1600, with a passing threshold set at a scaled score of 1400.

faqs.question: How does TUTOR PROCTORED EXAMS assist CPhT candidates?
faqs.answer: We offer 1-on-1 pharmacy math tutoring, top 200 brand/generic flashcard drills, federal law summaries, and timed PTCB mock tests.
